title: Repeated Employer-Liable Shortfalls: Rate Points on the Shortfall Late Charge
content:
Repeated employer-liable shortfalls add to the late charge rate on a shortfall notice the employer is liable for under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement:

- where at least 3 employer-liable shortfall notices, this one included, were booked on entry dates from which fewer than 12 whole months have passed to today, 0.5 percentage points are added;
- where exactly 2 were, 0.25 percentage points are added;
- otherwise none.

A whole month from an entry date is reached on the same day of the month as that entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day; the count covers the employer-liable shortfall notices on the agreement, the notice charged included.

| Employer-liable notices in the window, the charged one included | Points added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.5 |
| 2 | 0.25 |
| 1 | none |

A notice booked on the 5th of a month counts while today is on or before the 4th of the month 12 months later; one booked on 29 February counts through the last day of February of the next year, which has no 29th, and drops out on 1 March (hypothetical dates).
